source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening and topic 4.1, printed pages 91-93.

blocks.text: Pichhli classes mein aap ne “levels of biological organization” (jandaron ki tarteeb ke darjay) parhe thay. Wahan biological molecules ka mukhtasar taaruf (introduction) mila tha. Ab hum carbohydrates, proteins, lipids aur nucleic acids ko tafseel se parhenge, aur saath hi pani ki ahmiyat aur conjugated molecules ka kirdar (role) bhi dekhenge.
